subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Famous Whistleblowers
description: A fast breakdown of Famous Whistleblowers for builders.

hook.text: Sherron Watkins warned Enron's CEO about accounting fraud. He ignored her. She went public. Enron collapsed.

buildup.text: Whistleblowers expose wrongdoing that organizations try to hide — from fraud to safety violations to corruption.

discovery.text: Cynthia Cooper uncovered WorldCom's $3.8 billion fraud. Time named her Person of the Year in 2002.

twist.text: Most whistleblowers face retaliation. Studies show 82% experience harassment, demotion, or termination.

climax.text: Whistleblowers protect the public at great personal cost. They deserve protection, not punishment.

punchline.text: She warned them. They ignored her. She saved us all.
